newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Pacific Gold has merger proposal.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Pacific Gold has merger proposal.

text.p: Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp has received Newmont Mining Corp's merger proposal and will have no comment at this time, spokeswoman Wendy Yang said.
In a brief statement, Santa Fe Pacific Gold said it "acknowledged receipt of a proposal from Newmont Mining Corp reflecting the terms publicly announced by Newmont Mining.
"There is no further comment at the present time," it added.

The company also pointed out it is one of the largest gold mining companies in North America with mines in Nevada and California and exploration offices and projects throughout the world. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
